u6a5354498c: The FLASH parameters are a set of parameters that the SDK uses to enable the FLASH write protection feature and multi-algorithm authorization.
u3d3acb47bc: If the SDK supports FLASH write protection and multi-algorithm authorization, the FLASH parameters that correspond to the chip's FLASH ID must be configured before FLASH write protection and multi-algorithm authorization can be enabled.
u71e05f9afb: Normally, the FLASH parameters are written into the chip's FLASH by the programmer.
u5c5287f016: However, during development and debugging you may need to do the following:
u073ef8bd3a: Enable the FLASH write protection parameter feature⟦1/⟧
ue02287c3ef: Reactivate the multi-algorithm authorization feature (for example, when multi-algorithm authorization stops working after the programmer has programmed the multi-algorithm authorization data)
uf38e20a135: You can specify the FLASH parameter file with the -flash-params option of isd_download.exe.
